serviceDescription: Aether Security is a veteran-founded cybersecurity consulting firm based in Las Vegas, NV. We provide hands-on advisory services for cloud service providers pursuing FedRAMP Certification under the Consolidated Rules for 2026 (FedRAMP 20x and Rev5), along with NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), CMMC readiness, privacy and data protection, and secure cloud architecture for GCC High and AWS environments. Aether Security acts as an advisor and does not perform independent FedRAMP assessments.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Key Security Indicator (KSI) alignment, machine-readable evidence and package design, certification class and path selection, and preparation for engagement with a FedRAMP-recognized independent assessor.
Readiness review, gap analysis, documentation development, and control implementation support for cloud service providers pursuing FedRAMP Certification (20x).
Guidance through each NIST RMF step, from system categorization and control selection through authorization to operate (ATO) and continuous monitoring.

Comparison of current practices against CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 requirements, prioritized remediation roadmap, and end-to-end support from scoping and SSP/POA&M documentation to assessment readiness.
Design, migration, and configuration of cloud environments to meet federal and regulatory requirements.
Programs and policies aligned with applicable privacy regulations and frameworks.
Continuous identification, prioritization, and remediation support for weaknesses across cloud and on-premises environments.
